description: This script ensures the existence of a proxy decode module for the 'entities' library in a Node.js project. It creates or overwrites 'node_modules/entities/lib/decode.js' with an adapter that re-exports decode functions from an ESM module, providing compatibility for consumers like '@vue/compiler-core' that rely on CommonJS.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates directory recursively for the specified path.

methods.name: writeStableAdapter
methods.description: Generates and writes a CommonJS proxy adapter for the 'entities' decoding functions.
